headline: Brazil Enacts Fiscal Adjustment Bill to Limit Spending and Meet Targets
summary: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva signed into law a fiscal adjustment bill approved by Congress. The new law changes fiscal rules, allowing the executive branch to limit spending to meet primary surplus targets starting in 2027.
why: Fiscal adjustment laws govern sovereign debt trajectories and public spending limits, influencing sovereign credit risk and macroeconomic stability in Latin America's largest economy.
